def problem(x: np.ndarray) -> float:
    """
    A synthetic benchmark function designed to exhibit specific ELA features.
    """
    x = np.asarray(x)
    if x.shape != (3,):

    f += np.sum(np.cos(x)) * 0.1

    # Sinc Function on all variables

            sinc_val *= np.sin(x[i]) / x[i]

            sinc_val *= 1.0 # sin(x)/x -> 1 as x->0
    f += 0.1 * sinc_val

    return float(f)
